text:
Type: sofa with chaise longue
Use: seating, lounging, stretching out; living room, family room
Style: contemporary, modern, retro
Materials: smooth leather upholstery with welted seams, dark wooden feet
Colors: turquoise blue, light teal, dark brown
Shape: L-shaped form, chaise on the left, rounded padded arms, soft rounded edges, fixed back and seat, short dark round feet, chunky and low
Feel: bold, fresh, playful, comfortable
Goes with: white or grey walls, light wood, yellow or coral accents; modern or retro living rooms

product.name: DAGARN
product.description: Durable coated fabric that has the same look and feel as leather.
